voices.name: l00
voices.text: The harder you chase money, <#0.3#> the faster it runs.
voices.caption: The harder you chase money, the faster it runs.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: People who thrive check their soul's mood <#0.2#> before they calculate.
voices.caption: People who thrive check their soul's mood before they calculate.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Does this work make my soul lighter, <#0.2#> or heavier?
voices.caption: Does this work make my soul lighter, or heavier?

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Work your soul loves doesn't wear you out. <#0.2#> So you keep going, <#0.2#> you go deeper, <#0.2#> and you create what no one else can.
voices.caption: Work your soul loves doesn't wear you out. So you keep going, you go deeper, and you create what no one else can.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: As Bong Joon-ho said, quoting Martin Scorsese, <#0.2#> the most personal is the most creative.
voices.caption: As Bong Joon-ho said, quoting Martin Scorsese, the most personal is the most creative.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: What ran away when you chased it <#0.2#> finds you when you walk your own path.
voices.caption: What ran away when you chased it finds you when you walk your own path.
